title: NCAA-to-NBA Player Projection
summary: A machine learning pipeline that predicts whether NCAA basketball players will land in the Top 25%, Middle 50%, or Bottom 25% of NBA performance outcomes, using feature engineering, clustering, and ensemble models trained with synthetic data augmentation to address class imbalance. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic training rows for underrepresented outcome classes.
evidence: predict_success.py:1385-1390 metadata=SingleTableMetadata(); generator=CTGANSynthesizer(metadata,...) or TVAESynthesizer(...); generator.fit/sample used for augmentation
